answer: Sybil resistance via personalized task variants. Each agent's challenge seed is SHA256(address, epoch), so accounts of one farm get different parameters. Any peer recomputes the seed and checks the answer solves that account's variant; a mismatch proves copying, so the registrar slashes 5% of the deposit. A sybil operator pays real compute per clone: N variants cost N derivations, and one reused answer ripples through the ledger as slashable evidence. Reputation stays terraced to verified variants, so a farm floating clones down a river of duplicate answers burns stake.
